name: beastlabai
description: Codex marketplace catalog for this repository. Its one entry installs packaging/codex/multi-llm/, the generated and checked-in plugin tree (plans/codex-native-plugin.md, D1) — never the repository root. This file also SHADOWS .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, which codex reads too and whose one entry has source './': with only that file present, `codex plugin add multi-llm@beastlabai` copied the entire working tree (264 MB, .git, .venv and gitignored scratch included) into the plugin cache at a version segment of 'local'. The entry's path must stay relative and inside the repository (R20′: anything else is skipped silently), its name must equal the plugin manifest's (R29), and it carries no version and no policy. tests/test_marketplace_manifest_location.py is the guard.
